<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="lduI47p3F8_GLc2lr9wU"> <mxGraphModel dx="2946" dy="3760" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 Start([User Query]) --> S1 subgraph S1[\"<b>Step 1 — Query Understanding</b>\"] 
 S1A[Intent Classification] --> S1E[Output: intent + entities + variants] 
 S1B[spaCy NER] --> S1E
 S1C[GLiNER NER] --> S1E
 S1D[LLM Query Rewrite] --> S1E
 end
 S1E --> S2

 subgraph S2[\"<b>Step 2 — Grounded Generation</b>\"]
 S2A[Backend: llama or qwen] --> S2B[LlamaGenerator / QwenGenerator]
 S2B --> S2C[Build prompt: Context + Question]
 S2C --> S2D[Output: initial answer]
 end
 S2D --> S3

 subgraph S3[\"<b>Step 3 — Early Detection</b>\"]
 S3A[BGE-M3 Embedder] --> S3B[Compute cosine similarity]
 S3B --> S3C[Build feature vector]
 S3C --> S3D[XGBoost Classifier]
 S3D --> S3E[Output: hallucination probability]
 end
 S3E --> S4

 subgraph S4[\"<b>Step 4 — Confidence Assessment (EEDC)</b>\"]
 S4A[NLI Entropy] --> S4E[EEDC: α·H + β·top1 + γ·cons + δ]
 S4B[Retrieval Top-1] --> S4E
 S4C[Self-Consistency] --> S4E
 S4E --> S4F[Sigmoid → Temperature Scaler]
 S4F --> S4G[Output: calibrated score]
 end
 S4G --> S5

 subgraph S5[\"<b>Step 5 — Atomic Claim Extraction</b>\"]
 S5A{Mode?} -->|rule| S5B[Regex Splitter]
 S5A -->|llm| S5C[LLM Splitter]
 S5A -->|hybrid| S5D[Rule + LLM fallback]
 S5B & S5C & S5D --> S5E[Tag provenance: intrinsic/extrinsic/aggregated]
 S5E --> S5F[Output: claims list]
 end
 S5F --> S6

 subgraph S6[\"<b>Step 6 — Hybrid Retrieval</b>\"]
 S6A[Query → BGE-M3] --> S6B[FAISS Dense Search]
 S6A2[Query String] --> S6C[BM25 Sparse Search]
 S6B --> S6D[RRF Fusion]
 S6C --> S6D
 S6D --> S6E[Output: top-K evidence]
 end
 S6E --> S7

 subgraph S7[\"<b>Step 7 — Reranking</b>\"]
 S7A[BGE-Reranker-v2 cross-encoder] --> S7B[Sort by relevance score]
 S7B --> S7C[Output: top-K reranked evidence]
 end
 S7C --> S8

 subgraph S8[\"<b>Step 8 — NLI Verification</b>\"]
 S8A[For each claim × evidence] --> S8B[DeBERTa-v3-MNLI]
 S8B --> S8C{Label?}
 S8C -->|entail| S8D[supported]
 S8C -->|contradict| S8E[contradicted]
 S8C -->|neutral| S8F[unknown]
 S8D & S8E & S8F --> S8G[Output: per-claim verdicts + citations]
 end
 S8G --> S9

 subgraph S9[\"<b>Step 9 — Confidence Fusion</b>\"]
 S9A[sim: 0.30 | ret: 0.20 | nli: 0.25 | cov: 0.15 | eedc: 0.10] --> S9B[Weighted Sum]
 S9B --> S9C[Output: overall confidence + per-claim scores]
 end
 S9C --> S10

 subgraph S10[\"<b>Step 10 — Regeneration</b>\"]
 S10A[Find bad claims] --> S10B{Mode?}
 S10B -->|stub| S10C[KEEP answer]
 S10B -->|evidence| S10D[Join supported claims]
 S10B -->|regenerate| S10E[Llama 3.1 rewrite]
 S10C & S10D & S10E --> S10F[Output: final answer]
 end
 S10F --> S11

 subgraph S11[\"<b>Step 11 — Final Gate</b>\"]
 S11A[Confidence + unsupported ratio] --> S11B{PASS / REGEN / ABSTAIN?}
 S11B -->|conf ≥ 0.70 & no bad| S11C[PASS]
 S11B -->|conf < 0.30 or ≥ 50% bad| S11D[ABSTAIN]
 S11B -->|gray zone| S11E{attempts left?}
 S11E -->|yes| S11F[REGEN back to step 10]
 S11E -->|no| S11G[best of PASS / ABSTAIN]
 end
 S11C & S11D & S11F & S11G --> S12

 subgraph S12[\"<b>Step 12 — Explainable Response</b>\"]
 S12A[All pipeline state] --> S12B[JSON payload]
 S12A --> S12C[Markdown report]
 S12B & S12C --> S12D[Output: report_json + report_markdown]
 end
 S12D --> S13

 subgraph S13[\"<b>Step 13 — Evaluation</b>\"]
 S13A[Per-query state] --> S13B[Generation: BLEU, ROUGE-L, BERTScore]
 S13A --> S13C[Retrieval: R@K, P@K, MRR, nDCG]
 S13A --> S13D[Verification: claim P/R/F1]
 S13A --> S13E[Detection: Acc, P, R, F1, ROC-AUC]
 S13A --> S13F[Reduction: HRR, CCR, VSR]
 S13B & S13C & S13D & S13E & S13F --> S13G[Append to data/metrics.json]
 end
 S13G --> End([PipelineResult])",
 "config": null
